name: @ceragon/shared-contracts
description: Shared type contracts for Ceragon package intelligence (Ingestion + Backend)

scripts.prepack: npm run clean && npm run check:ai-security-generated
scripts.generate:ai-security: npm run build && npm run validate:ai-security-sources && node scripts/generate-ai-security-artifact.cjs --output generated/ai-security/0.2.0
scripts.check:ai-security-generated: npm run build && npm run validate:ai-security-sources && node scripts/check-ai-security-generated.cjs
scripts.test: npm run build && node scripts/test-security-taxonomy.cjs && node scripts/test-vulnerability-applicability.cjs && node scripts/test-m3-contracts.cjs && node scripts/test-governance-profile.cjs && node scripts/test-runtime-adapter-contract.cjs && node scripts/test-ai-security-policy-v1-contract.cjs && npm run validate:ai-security-sources && node scripts/test-ai-security-portable-artifact.cjs
